bar.text: ...SMALL CRAFT ADVISORY IN EFFECT THROUGH TUESDAY AFTERNOON... Combined seas 9 to 12 ft. Bar conditions rough. Maximum ebb current will occur around 300 AM and 315 PM Monday, and 345 AM Tuesday. The Monday afternoon ebb will be very strong.
bar.ebb: afternoon ebb will be very strong
